enchantments.tooltip: +4 Enhancement Bonus: +4 enhancement bonus to Armor Class, attack and damage rolls.
Improved Bashing: This shield does an additional 2 to 12 damage when used to shield bash.
Shield Bashing +10%: +10% Enhancement bonus to your chance of a Secondary Shield Bash. This stacks with bonuses granted by any relevant feats.
Damage Reduction 5/Piercing: Reduces physical damage by 5, except from Piercing attacks.
Sheltering +3: +3 Enhancement bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings
